# Operator Health Check — 2026-03-13 06:51 UTC

## Summary
System is up but degraded. Core host resources are within limits, GPU is heavily allocated but not saturated, and the OpenClaw RPC endpoint responds on loopback. Several service health issues need follow-up.

## PM2
- Online: agent-log, gpu-router, iam-chat-proxy, kira-admin, kira-app, kira-dashboard, oopuo-website, openclaw-bridge, openclaw-gateway, stella-tax, whatsapp-bridge, zenithcred-website
- Stopped: whisper
- Note: openclaw-gateway shows 4494 restarts and only 2s uptime in PM2 at check time.

## Docker
Running containers found across staging, IAM, Omiximo, Langfuse, n8n, Ollama, and related stacks.

Degraded containers:
- langfuse_langfuse-web_1 — restarting
- lidaros-frontend-1 — unhealthy
- omiximo-email-automation — unhealthy

Healthy/Running examples:
- iam-staging-nginx — up
- iam-ghost / iam-mysql — up (mysql healthy)
- inventree stack — up (db healthy, redis healthy)
- ollama — up
- n8n — up

## Disk
- Root filesystem /dev/sda1: 452G used / 210G free / 69% usage
- No disk alert threshold breached (>85%).

## Memory
- RAM: 11.8GB used / 27.5GB total
- Available: 15.7GB
- Swap: 0 configured
- No RAM alert threshold breached (>90%).

## GPU
- NVIDIA RTX 4090
- Driver 580.126.09 / CUDA 13.0
- Memory usage: 20550 MiB / 24564 MiB (~83.7%)
- Utilization: 0% at sample time
- Main process: VLLM::EngineCore using ~20.5GB VRAM

## OpenClaw Gateway
- RPC probe: OK
- Listening: 127.0.0.1:18789
- Bind: loopback only
- systemd runtime: stopped/inactive (last exit 203)
- Service config warning: embedded OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN in service, reinstall recommended
- Additional note: service config looks out of date/non-standard and multiple gateway-like legacy services are present

## Assessment
- Host capacity is fine.
- Immediate attention needed for service health drift, not for disk/RAM exhaustion.
- Highest-risk items: whisper stopped, Langfuse web restart loop, OpenClaw gateway service drift, unhealthy Docker services.

## Suggested next actions
1. Check PM2 logs for whisper and decide whether it should be online or intentionally stopped.
2. Inspect docker logs and health checks for langfuse_langfuse-web_1, lidaros-frontend-1, and omiximo-email-automation.
3. Normalize OpenClaw gateway deployment: confirm whether PM2 or systemd is the source of truth, then remove stale duplicate service definitions and reinstall the supported service if needed.
